title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Anatomy of a Candlestick

questions.text: What does the body of a candlestick represent?
options: The highest price tested during the period
The distance between the open and close prices
The volume traded during the period
The same as the wick or shadow
questions.explanation: The body is the distance between the open and close prices for the period.

questions.text: A long upper wick indicates that sellers pushed the price back down after an upward move, showing rejection at higher levels.
questions.explanation: A long upper wick forms when price is driven up then rejected, leaving sellers in control.
